2801-the-commonwealth-of-oceana.title: The Commonwealth Of Oceana
2801-the-commonwealth-of-oceana.creator: James Harrington
2801-the-commonwealth-of-oceana.description: A book by James Harrington. Harrington prepared himself for foreign travel by study of modern languages, but before he went abroad, and while he was still under age, his father died and he succeeded to his patrimony. The socage tenure of his estate gave him free choice of his own guardian, and he chose his mother’s mother, Lady Samuel.

arxiv-1510-05460.title: Shortest paths in one-counter systems
arxiv-1510-05460.creator: Dmitry Chistikov \rsuper a, Wojciech Czerwiński \rsuper b, Piotr Hofman \rsuper b, Michał Pilipczuk \rsuper b, Michael Wehar \rsuper c
arxiv-1510-05460.description: A 2015 arXiv research paper by Dmitry Chistikov \rsuper a, Wojciech Czerwiński \rsuper b, Piotr Hofman \rsuper b, Michał Pilipczuk \rsuper b, Michael Wehar \rsuper c. We show that any one-counter automaton with n n states, if its language is non-empty, accepts some word of length at most O ⁡ ( n 2 ) O(n^{2}) . This closes the gap between the previously known upper bound of O ⁡ ( n 3 ) O(n^{3}) and lower bound of Ω ⁡ ( n 2 ) \mathrm{\Omega}(n^{2}) .

arxiv-1806-01507.title: Using the AIDA Language to Formally Organize Scientific Claims
arxiv-1806-01507.creator: Tobias Kuhn
arxiv-1806-01507.description: Abstract Scientific communication still mainly relies on natural language written in scientific papers, which makes the described knowledge very difficult to access with automatic means. We can therefore only make limited use of formal knowledge organization methods to support researchers and other interested parties with features such as automatic aggregations, fact checking, consistency checking, question answering, and powerful semantic search.

arxiv-2110-13185.title: Generalized Multi-Task Learning from Substantially Unlabeled Multi-Source Medical Image Data
arxiv-2110-13185.creator:
ame Ayaan Haque \email ayaanzhaque@gmail.com, 
ame Abdullah-Al-Zubaer Imran \email aimran@stanford.edu, 
ame Adam Wang \email adamwang@stanford.edu, 
ame Demetri Terzopoulos \email dt@cs.ucla.edu
arxiv-2110-13185.description: Abstract Deep learning-based models, when trained in a fully-supervised manner, can be effective in performing complex image analysis tasks, although contingent upon the availability of large labeled datasets. Especially in the medical imaging domain, however, expert image annotation is expensive, time-consuming, and prone to variability. Semi-supervised learning from limited quantities of labeled data has shown promise as an alternative.

arxiv-2204-04044.title: Confidence Score for Unsupervised Foreground Background Separation of Document Images
arxiv-2204-04044.creator: Soumyadeep Dey, Pratik Jawanpuria
arxiv-2204-04044.description: Abstract Foreground-background separation is an important problem in document image analysis. Popular unsupervised binarization methods (such as the Sauvola’s algorithm) employ adaptive thresholding to classify pixels as foreground or background. In this work, we propose a novel approach for computing confidence scores of the classification in such algorithms. This score provides an insight of the confidence level of the prediction.

arxiv-2207-14529.title: The Effects of Data Quality on Machine Learning Performance on Tabular Data
arxiv-2207-14529.creator: Sedir Mohammed, Lukas Budach, Moritz Feuerpfeil, Nina Ihde, Andrea Nathansen, Nele Noack, Hendrik Patzlaff, Felix Naumann, Hazar Harmouch
arxiv-2207-14529.description: Abstract . Modern artificial intelligence (AI) applications require large quantities of training and test data. This need creates critical challenges not only concerning the availability of such data, but also regarding its quality. For example, incomplete, erroneous, or inappropriate training data can lead to unreliable models that ultimately produce poor decisions.

arxiv-2208-10423.title: Graph Connectivity with Noisy Queries 0 0 footnotetext: This work is partially supported by NTUA Basic Research Grant (PEBE 2020) “Algorithm Design through Learning Theory: Learning-Augmented and Data-Driven Online Algorithms (LEADAlgo)”.
arxiv-2208-10423.creator: Dimitris Fotakis fotakis@cs.ntua.gr, Evangelia Gergatsouli gergatsouli@wisc.edu, Charilaos Pipis chpipis@softlab.ntua.gr, Miltiadis Stouras miltiadis.stouras@epfl.ch, Christos Tzamos tzamos@wisc.edu
arxiv-2208-10423.description: Abstract Graph connectivity is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem that arises in many practical applications, where usually a spanning subgraph of a network is used for its operation. However, in the real world, links may fail unexpectedly deeming the networks non-operational, while checking whether a link is damaged is costly and possibly erroneous.

arxiv-2211-14685.title: Large and Versatile Plasmonic Enhancement of Photoluminescence Using Colloidal Metallic Nanocubes
arxiv-2211-14685.creator: Mohammad Khaywah, Audrey Potdevin, François Réveret, Rachid Mahiou, Youcef Ouerdane, Anthony Désert, Stéphane Parola, Geneviève Chadeyron, Emmanuel Centeno, Rafik Smaali, Antoine Moreau
arxiv-2211-14685.description: Abstract Improving phosphor photoluminescence efficiency is a key parameter to boost the performances of many optical devices. In this work, colloidal silver nanocubes, homogeneously spread on a luminescent surface, have proved to help both injecting and extracting light in and out of the photoluminescent layer and hence contributed significantly to the enhancement of the fluorescence.

arxiv-2310-06682.title: On the importance of catalyst-adsorbate 3D interactions for relaxed energy predictions
arxiv-2310-06682.creator: Alvaro Carbonero, Alexandre Duval, Victor Schmidt, Santiago Miret, Alex Hernandez-Garcia, Yoshua Bengio, David Rolnick
arxiv-2310-06682.description: Abstract The use of machine learning for material property prediction and discovery has traditionally centered on graph neural networks that incorporate the geometric configuration of all atoms. However, in practice not all this information may be readily available, e.g. when evaluating the potentially unknown binding of adsorbates to catalyst.

arxiv-2311-15984.title: Extraction of the microscopic properties of quasi-particles using deep neural networks
arxiv-2311-15984.creator: Olga Soloveva, Andrea Palermo, Elena Bratkovskaya
arxiv-2311-15984.description: Abstract We use deep neural networks (DNN) to obtain the microscopic characteristics of partons in terms of dynamical degrees of freedom on the basis of an off-shell quasiparticle description. We aim to infer masses and widths of quasi-gluons, up/down, and strange quarks using constraints on the macroscopic thermodynamic observables obtained by the first-principles calculations lattice QCD.

arxiv-2402-05674.title: A High Dimensional Model for Adversarial Training: Geometry and Trade-Offs
arxiv-2402-05674.creator: Kasimir Tanner, Matteo Vilucchio, Bruno Loureiro, Florent Krzakala
arxiv-2402-05674.description: Abstract This work investigates adversarial training in the context of margin-based linear classifiers in the high-dimensional regime where the dimension d d and the number of data points n n diverge with a fixed ratio α = n / d \alpha=n/d .

arxiv-2406-05771.title: White Dwarf Envelops and Temperature Corrections in Exponential f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) Gravity
arxiv-2406-05771.creator: Gabriel Farrugia, Carlos Gafa’, Jackson Levi Said
arxiv-2406-05771.description: Abstract Compact stars have long served as a test bed of gravitational models and their coupling with stellar matter. In this work, we explore the behavior of an exponential model in f ⁡ ( T ) f(T) gravity through the Tolman–Oppenheimer–Volkoff equation. This is performed for different envelope thicknesses.

arxiv-2408-02008.title: Engineering Helical Superconductors with Multiple Majorana Kramers Pairs via Higher-Order Rashba Spin-Orbit Coupling
arxiv-2408-02008.creator: Qi-Sheng Xu, Zi-Ming Wang, Chui-Zhen Chen, Lun-Hui Hu, Rui Wang, Dong-Hui Xu
arxiv-2408-02008.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Qi-Sheng Xu, Zi-Ming Wang, Chui-Zhen Chen, Lun-Hui Hu, Rui Wang, Dong-Hui Xu. The momentum dependence of Rashba spin-orbit coupling (RSOC) is a key ingredient for engineering topological superconductors (TSCs), yet research has overwhelmingly focused on its linear-in-momentum form. This focus has restricted time-reversal invariant TSCs to helical p p -wave states, which are characterized by a ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} topological invariant that permits at most a single Majorana Kramers pair at a given boundary.

arxiv-2410-20960.title: Ultrathin 3R- MoS 2 \text{MoS}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} metasurfaces with atomically precise edges for efficient nonlinear nanophotonics
arxiv-2410-20960.creator: George Zograf, Bet ü l K ü ç ü k ö z, Alexander Yu. Polyakov, Maria Bancerek, Abhay V. Agrawal, Witlef Wieczorek, Tomasz J. Antosiewicz, Timur O. Shegai
arxiv-2410-20960.description: Abstract Dielectric metasurfaces that combine high-index materials with optical nonlinearities are widely recognized for their potential in various quantum and classical nanophotonic applications. However, the fabrication of high-quality metasurfaces poses significant material-dependent challenges, as their designs are often susceptible to disorder, defects, and scattering losses, which are particularly prone to occur at the edges of nanostructured features.

arxiv-2412-13146.title: Syntactic Transfer to Kyrgyz Using the Treebank Translation Method
arxiv-2412-13146.creator: Anton Alekseev, Alina Tillabaeva, Gulnara Dzh. Kabaeva, Sergey I. Nikolenko
arxiv-2412-13146.description: Abstract The Kyrgyz language, as a low-resource language, requires significant effort to create high-quality syntactic corpora. This study proposes an approach to simplify the development process of a syntactic corpus for Kyrgyz. We present a tool for transferring syntactic annotations from Turkish to Kyrgyz based on a treebank translation method.

arxiv-2501-03421.title: Linear stability of charged warm holes
arxiv-2501-03421.creator: Radouane Gannouji, Alejandro Guzmán Antonucci
arxiv-2501-03421.description: Abstract Charged black holes are known to suffer from an interior instability associated with the presence of the Cauchy horizon. Recently, a hairy charged black hole was proposed that avoids the formation of a Cauchy horizon. It is natural to question whether this instability might manifest in the exterior solution.

arxiv-2504-11409.title: Minitron-SSM: Efficient Hybrid Language Model Compression through Group-Aware SSM Pruning
arxiv-2504-11409.creator: Ali Taghibakhshi*, Sharath Turuvekere Sreenivas*, Saurav Muralidharan*, Marcin Chochowski*, Yashaswi Karnati*, Raviraj Joshi, Ameya Sunil Mahabaleshwarkar, Zijia Chen, Yoshi Suhara, Oluwatobi Olabiyi, Daniel Korzekwa, Mostofa Patwary, Mohammad Shoeybi, Jan Kautz, Bryan Catanzaro, Ashwath Aithal, Nim
arxiv-2504-11409.description: Abstract Abstract: Hybrid LLM architectures that combine Attention and State Space Models (SSMs) achieve state-of-the-art accuracy and runtime performance. Recent work has demonstrated that applying compression and distillation to Attention-only models yields smaller, more accurate models at a fraction of the training cost. In this work, we explore the effectiveness of compressing Hybrid architectures.

arxiv-2505-21155.title: Magnetic flux cancellation in a flux-emergence magnetohydrodynamics simulation of coronal hole eruptions and jets
arxiv-2505-21155.creator: Spiros Patsourakos, Vasilis Archontis
arxiv-2505-21155.description: Abstract Context. Observations have demonstrated that magnetic flux cancellation can be associated with coronal jets and eruptions taking place in coronal holes. However, magnetic flux cancellation is barely reported in magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulations of coronal jets and eruptions which employ emerging twisted flux tubes. Aims.

arxiv-2604-10203.title: Optimal Analog Beamforming and Power Allocation for Multiuser TDMA Systems
arxiv-2604-10203.creator: Songnan Gu, Chongjun Ouyang, Hao Jiang, Xingqi Zhang

pmc-10619046.title: Association of parental self-efficacy with loneliness, isolation and community commitment in mothers with infant children in Japan: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10619046.creator: Azusa Arimoto, Etsuko Tadaka
pmc-10619046.description: ObjectivesParental self-efficacy is defined as an individual’s appraisal of their competence in the parental role and is one of the factors targeted by parenting interventions. Factors related to parental self-efficacy among mothers, focusing mainly on individual and family characteristics, have been clarified; however, there are limited findings on community/societal factors related to parental self-efficacy among mothers.

pmc-10768395.title: Artificial intelligence system for the detection of Barrett’s esophagus
pmc-10768395.creator: Ming-Chang Tsai, Hsu-Heng Yen, Hui-Yu Tsai, Yu-Kai Huang, Yu-Sin Luo, Edy Kornelius, Wen-Wei Sung, Chun-Che Lin, Ming-Hseng Tseng, Chi-Chih Wang
pmc-10768395.description: BACKGROUNDBarrett’s esophagus (BE), which has increased in prevalence worldwide, is a precursor for esophageal adenocarcinoma. Although there is a gap in the detection rates between endoscopic BE and histological BE in current research, we trained our artificial intelligence (AI) system with images of endoscopic BE and tested the system with images of histological BE.

pmc-11300059.title: Spatial Distribution and Pollution Assessment of Metals in Sediments of the Babon River, Central Java, Indonesia
pmc-11300059.creator: Haeruddin Haeruddin, Agoes Soegianto, Frida Purwanti, Arif Rahman, Carolyn Melissa Payus, Hefni Effendi
pmc-11300059.description: Background The Babon River is one of the drainage channels in Semarang, Indonesia, that is used for drinking water, irrigated agriculture of paddy fields and gardens, fish farming media, and the disposal of industrial wastewater. This study aimed to assess the spatial distribution of metals in the sediment of the Babon River through the utilization of different pollution indices.

pmc-11394681.title: The Role of Natural Products in Immunopharmacology
pmc-11394681.creator: Giulia Accardi, Danila Di Majo, Anna Aiello
pmc-11394681.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). e range of conditions. However, scientific validation of these traditional uses is often lacking. Bridging this gap is essential for the development of new pharmaceuticals or functional foods. In this Special Issue, we have collected articles that describe natural products isolated using molecular approaches, with applications aimed at understanding the mechanisms of action in improving different kinds of disorders, including immune pathologies.

pmc-11691982.title: EYE MOVEMENTS REVEAL AGE DIFFERENCES IN HOW AROUSAL MODULATES MECHANISMS OF ATTENTIONAL CONTROL
pmc-11691982.creator: Andy Kim, Kristine Nguyen, Mara Mather
pmc-11691982.description: The arousal-biased competition theory posits that inducing arousal increases attentional priority of salient stimuli while reducing priority of non-salient stimuli. However, older adults are hypothesized to exhibit dysfunction in the locus coeruleus-noradrenaline system that mediates both global arousal and attentional control. Unlike in young adults, older adults primarily do not exhibit shifts in attentional priority under increased arousal.

pmc-12457835.title: Protocol for the Preparation of a Recombinant Treacle Fragment for Liquid–Liquid Phase Separation (LLPS) Assays
pmc-12457835.creator: Nadezhda V Petrova, Konstantin I Balagurov, Sergey V Razin, Artem K Velichko
pmc-12457835.description: Liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) underlies the spatial organization of the nucleolus, a membraneless organelle responsible for ribosomal RNA (rRNA) transcription and ribosome subunit assembly. One of the key proteins involved in the formation of the fibrillar center of the nucleolus is the treacle, an intrinsically disordered protein that contains low-complexity repeats enriched in charged amino acid residues.

pmc-12734873.title: Pharmaceuticals, Pesticides, and Poly- and Perfluoroalkyl Substances at Surface Water Occurrence Levels—Impact of Compound Specific Physicochemical Properties on Nanofiltration and Reverse Osmosis Processes
pmc-12734873.creator: Jelena Šurlan, Claudia F. Galinha, Nikola Maravić, Carla Brazinha, Igor Antić, Jelena Živančev, Nataša Đurišić-Mladenović, Zita Šereš, João G. Crespo
pmc-12734873.description: Pharmaceutically active compounds (PhACs), pesticides, and poly- and perfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are increasingly detected in surface waters at trace concentrations, raising concerns for both aquatic systems and, consequently, human health. Conventional solutions are insufficient to achieve complete removal at trace compound concentrations, highlighting the need for advanced separation technologies.

pmc-13053562.title: Symptomatic Dermatographism Misattributed to Cockroach Exposure: A Diagnostic Pitfall
pmc-13053562.creator: Simona Kogan, Sumeet Bhardwaj, Suchana Ghimire, Arushi Tewari, Rishima Tewari
pmc-13053562.description: Allergen exposure can present with a broad clinical spectrum. Individuals exposed to allergens may develop respiratory diseases such as asthma, skin manifestations such as urticaria, and potentially anaphylaxis. For those who reside in urban or unsanitary environments, cockroaches can serve as an unfortunate and persistent exposure to such allergens. Cockroach allergens are classically associated with IgE-mediated respiratory diseases.

pmc-13380646.title: A scoping review of computational models on human glucose cerebral metabolism
pmc-13380646.creator: Parissa Fereydouni-Forouzandeh, Andréanne Michaud, Nicolas Doyon, Simon Duchesne

pmc-13411432.title: Rethinking Basic Science Teaching in Medical Education: A Viewpoint on Its Past, Present, and Future
pmc-13411432.creator: Kátia M Avena, Ana Paula A Brito, Luiz F Quintanilha, Mariana Araújo-Pereira, Bruno B Andrade, Matthew Balcarras

pmc-13563254.title: Patterns of Health Care Spending in Prostate Cancer
pmc-13563254.creator: Jiaye Shen, Aaron J. Katz, Yahui Xie, Ronald C. Chen, Mutlay Sayan
pmc-13563254.description: Key PointsQuestionHow did spending for prostate cancer–related health care change from 2012 to 2021, and which components of care accounted for these changes?FindingsIn this population-level economic evaluation using Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results–Medicare data, prostate cancer–related expenditures increased from $504 million in 2012 to $1.9 billion in 2021.

pmc-13570207.title: Regression to Ambiguous Pain Classification by Introducing the Term ‘Mixed Pain’; A Commentary on Freynhagen et al. Regarding the Mixed Pain Concept
pmc-13570207.creator: Eva Kosek
pmc-13570207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The procedure resulted in the definition of ‘mixed pain’ as: ‘pain that is associated with a lesion, disease, or disorder resulting in an overlap of at least two mechanistic pain descriptors (nociceptive, neuropathic, or nociplastic)’.
